releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.189: Smart Reminder and Personal Calendar alarm scheduling now continues when full-screen UI permission is unavailable; Android may still restrict full-screen wake display. Existing Private Locker and Diary Lock features are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 307: Note Lock PIN placeholder text is enlarged according to prompt length; short prompts are doubled where they fit, longer prompts are moderately enlarged and sized to the available mobile width to prevent clipping. Only Note PIN prompt appearance changed; PIN entry, validation, recovery, and saved notes remain unchanged.
